Digest.caption: Three thousand two hundred double SHA-256 digests of random 32-byte inputs, grouped by the first hexadecimal digit of the digest. The bars are level because a digest is unpredictable: no first digit is likelier than another, which is why a hash can identify a transaction and why changing one byte of a transaction gives an identifier that shares nothing with the old one.
